enforcing_agencies: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
applicable_to: commercial lodging establishments with 10 or more rooms
encouraged for all lodging establishments regardless of size
recordkeeping_requirements: retain copies of all annual certificates of completion
maintain sufficient records to show compliance with Section 114.0051, Texas Business and Commerce Code
certificate_requirements: certificate of completion for each employee who completes the training
should include the date taken and course title
risks_or_constraints: training must be approved by the Office of the Attorney General
some training courses may require a subscription fee for ongoing access
notes: Multiple organizations have developed approved training courses
Most approved training courses are available online, though some may require in-person sessions
